text:
riley: Quick thread: launching Community RefApp + "Bench & Ship" webinar in two weeks. Needs: blog launch post, short benchmark narrative for blog + slide, webinar landing copy (two headlines), and inbound form->HubSpot routing with role tags and UTMs. Who takes what?
sam: I’ll draft the launch post and the bench micro-narrative. Plan: keep bench to 3 bullets: workload, models, p50/p95, cost/1k tokens, plus a 35-word dev tweet.
zoe: I can help with benchmark visuals — simple sparkline + single-value callouts (p95 and $/1k). Will export PNGs sized for blog and slides.
anya: I’ll own HubSpot mapping and UTMs. Proposed UTM: utm_source=refapp, utm_campaign=bench_ship_q2. Role mapping: engineer/product/other -> tags eng, pm, other. Also add lead property "interested_in_dedicated" when they check the box.
morgan: I’ll take the webinar landing copy + A/B headlines. Draft options: A) "Bench & Ship: Build a low-latency chat refapp" B) "Ship faster: OSS refapp + live benchmarks" Leaning A. CTA: "Register to follow the build + live benchmarks."
riley: Nice. Quick asks: Sam add a 1-line PM-friendly takeaway for the post (non-technical). Zoe export the PNGs and drop links in the PR. Anya, confirm a test lead appears before publish.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/community-refapp/pull/501 — includes post draft, bench table, tweet blurb, and PM takeaway. PM takeaway: "Small infra and model tweaks improved predictability and cost without sacrificing answer quality." Tweet (35w): "Build a low-latency chat app in one session. We open-source the refapp, share configs, and show live benchmarks that cut p95 and cost on open models. Join the Bench & Ship webinar: [link]"
zoe: PNGs uploaded to PR assets: bench-sparkline.png, p95-callout.png. Sizes: blog header and slide pack both included.
anya: Routing stub added in PR comments: "HubSpot form id=9001; utm_source=refapp; utm_campaign=bench_ship_q2; role mapping -> eng/pm/other; set property interested_in_dedicated when checkbox checked". Will post HubSpot test screenshot here once I see it.
morgan: Headline A locked as primary. Alt B stays in PR. Also added two 8-word email subject options for the campaign.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: staging landing page deploy scheduled 2026-11-02T22:00:00Z.
anya: Test lead received in HubSpot with tags and UTM params intact. Screenshot attached to PR. Pixel firing OK.
riley: Timeline: publish blog + open regs 48h before webinar so we can run 2 reminder emails. Sam finalize copy tonight; Zoe finalize images; Anya confirm flows; Morgan finalize landing copy. Thanks all :rocket:
